findings.title: data_path read path emits duplicate and X-valued responses per read burst
findings.detail: The read capture FSM pushes the response FIFO on EVERY RD_CAPTURE cycle (data_path.sv rd_capture_valid), so a BURST_CTRL_CYC=2 burst enqueues two entries per read; rd_rsp_valid (= ~rd_empty) then streams both toward wb_port. In the path_18 chain run this produced 60 dp_rd_rsp responses with X-valued data on many (uninitialised FIFO entries escaping to the interface, caught by the scoreboard's X-value check), duplicate wb acks, and wb_port's own embedded p_tag/p_stall_hold assertions firing 20+ times. One read must produce exactly one host-word response; capture should accumulate the burst's beats, then push once.
